{{Quote|I hope you're here to work, because we've got plenty to do. A respected Naboo scientist has just arrived on Rori. This individual has been studying Gungan weapons technology and is crucial to the Alliance's efforts. High Inquisitor Sikander has placed a deathmark on his head so we need to act fast. Can I count on you to get this Naboo scientist back here safely?|Commander Vordin Sildor|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Vordin Sildor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He operated out of [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. He held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vordin Sildor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
